findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70%
findings.body: In .embedded-posts .topic-meta-data h5 a the old rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The new rule is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The light-theme branch changed from 30% to 70%, so the default light theme will render much lighter than before instead of preserving the original color. It should be 30% / 70%.

findings.title: group-member name lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: In .user-main .user-stream .group-member-info .name the old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The replacement is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme value no longer matches the original 30%, changing the light-theme appearance. It should be 30% for $primary and 70% for $secondary to be consistent with the rest of the PR.

findings.title: group-member name lightness changed from 30% to 50%
findings.body: In .user-main .user-stream .group-member-info .name the old value was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The new value is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). This alters the light-theme color instead of preserving 30% / 70%. It should use primary 30% and secondary 70%.

findings.title: topic-map h3 lightness changed from 20% to 50%
findings.body: In .topic-map h3 the old rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). It was replaced with dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme branch is now 50% instead of 20%, making the heading lighter on light themes. It should be 20% / 80% like the desktop equivalent.

findings.title: custom-message-length lightness inverted from 70% to 30%
findings.body: The old rule was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). The new rule is dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). The light-theme value dropped from 70% to 30%, which will make the text much darker on the default light theme. It should preserve 70% for $primary and use 30% for $secondary.

findings.title: Missed dark-theme conversion leaves light-only color
findings.body: The rule .topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification still uses color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%) without dark-light-choose. Every other 50% primary text color in the same file was converted to dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). Left as-is, this badge will be too light/washed on dark themes, defeating the purpose of the PR.
